title: Two Cups and a String
paras: Mina makes a cup telephone with her [[grandfather|grandfather]]. He is seventy and [[healthy|healthy]], and he likes making things. Mina is very [[dear|dear]] to him. They [[walk|walk]] to his small work room behind the house. There are a [[lot|lot]] of boxes under the table. They [[find|find]] two paper cups in one box. They also need a long piece of string and a small tool for making holes.

First, he makes a hole in the bottom of each cup. Mina puts one end of the string through each hole. She makes a big knot at each end. The knots keep the string in place. But she pulls too hard and breaks one cup. She feels [[sorry|sorry]]. He smiles and gives her another cup. Soon their telephone is ready to try.

They stand far apart and keep the string straight and tight. Mina speaks into her cup. He holds his cup to his [[ear|ear]]. Her voice makes the string move, and sound reaches his cup. They [[laugh|laugh]] when he hears her tiny voice. A neighbour sees them and asks to buy the telephone for his son. But Mina wants to keep it, so they do not [[sell|sell]] it. It stays by the window, ready for another happy talk.
zh: 米娜和她的爷爷或外公一起做杯子电话。他七十岁了，身体健康，喜欢动手做东西。他非常疼爱米娜。他们走到屋后他的小工作间。桌子下面有许多箱子。他们在一个箱子里找到两个纸杯。他们还需要一根长线和一个用来打孔的小工具。
首先，他在每个杯子的底部打一个孔。米娜把线的两端分别穿过两个孔，再在每一端打一个大结。这些结可以固定住线。但是，她拉得太用力，弄破了一个杯子。她感到很抱歉。他笑了笑，又给她一个杯子。很快，他们的电话就做好了，可以试用了。
他们站得远远的，把线拉直、绷紧。米娜对着她的杯子说话。他把自己的杯子贴在耳朵上。她的声音让线振动，声音就传到了他的杯子里。他听见她细小的声音时，两个人都笑了。一位邻居看见了他们，提出想买下这个电话送给自己的儿子。但是米娜想留下它，所以他们没有卖掉它。它被放在窗边，等着下一次愉快的交谈。

q.s: The box with the two paper cups is on the table.
q.why: 装纸杯的箱子在桌子下面。

q.s: Mina breaks a cup because she pulls too hard.
q.why: 文中明确说她拉得太用力，弄破了杯子。

q.s: They plan to make a second telephone the next day.
q.why: 文章未提到第二天再做一个电话。
